latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Daily Digest, an automated, AI-assisted tech news summarizer:

- Fetches RSS feeds from 92 top Hacker News blogs (curated by Karpathy) plus 3 Chinese tech media (36氪, 少数派, InfoQ中文).
- Uses AI to score and filter articles, generating a daily digest with Chinese-translated titles, category grouping, trend highlights, and visual statistics.
- Supports both OpenAI-compatible and Gemini API keys, with automatic fallback.
- Interactive setup flow: configurable time range, number of top articles, output language, and persistent user config.
- Generates structured Markdown reports with highlights, summaries, categorized articles, and visual data charts.
- Provides clear guidance for setup, configuration persistence, and troubleshooting.
